rationale:
One coherent defect: SingleMapping.fromJson passed map['names'] directly to List<String>.from, which throws when a source map omits the optional 'names' field. The minimized production patch is a single expression change in lib/parser.dart (`map['names']` -> `map['names'] ?? []`), matching the commit subject 'Handle null names field when parsing source map files' and traceability to verified issue/PR 40. The trigger is the unmodified upstream test portion of the same fixing commit: it adds fixture MAP_WITH_SOURCE_LOCATION_AND_MISSING_NAMES (identical to the existing MAP_WITH_SOURCE_LOCATION minus the names key) and asserts the same parse results as the pre-existing 'parse with source location' test, so it exercises only pre-existing API (parse, SingleMapping.lines, entries, sourceNameId) and introduces no API added by the fix. The minimized patch is production-only, with no refactor, formatting, feature, docs, or config edits. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs reports all gates passed, including build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential and full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers on selector 'test/parser_test.dart::parse with source location and missing names entry', trigger.fixed_clean, full_suite.fixed_all_green, and determinism across 3 repetitions / 32 matrix runs. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this null-'names' root cause duplicates no active registry entry, and dart-archive/source_maps#40 is in allowed_root_cause_ids.

The production change is a single initializer guard in SingleMapping.fromJson: names = List<String>.from(map['names']) becomes List<String>.from(map['names'] ?? []), which is exactly the 'null names field' failure named in the commit subject and traced to issue 40 via fix_commit_to_merged_pr_to_issue (verified_fix_issue_numbers=[40], PR 40). The trigger adds one fixture (MAP_WITH_SOURCE_LOCATION_AND_MISSING_NAMES, identical to the existing MAP_WITH_SOURCE_LOCATION fixture minus the 'names' key) and one test that calls the pre-existing public parse() and reads pre-existing SingleMapping members (lines, entries, column, sourceUrlId, sourceColumn, sourceLine, sourceNameId), so it depends on no API introduced by the fix and reproduces precisely the omitted-names input the fix guards. The minimized production patch touches only that one line in lib/parser.dart, with no formatting, refactor, config, or doc edits; the test-only hunk is separated into patches/trigger-tests.patch. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs reports all gates passed, including trigger.buggy_differential and full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers reproducing 'test/parser_test.dart::parse with source location and missing names entry', trigger.fixed_clean, full_suite.fixed_all_green, trigger.deterministic across 3 repetitions, and build.both_versions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry, and dart-archive/source_maps#40 is the supplied allowed key.
